files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Fixed

- Fixed clearing and reassigning contact (CC), event (EC), and task (TC) collection correlations in personal settings.
- Fixed removed collection correlations not remaining cleared after saving and synchronization.
- Prevented automatic recreation of the default Exchange calendar correlation after intentional removal.
- Restored automatic default calendar recovery when the calendar correlation is reassigned.

### Improved

- Improved persistence and handling of collection correlation changes.
- Updated compiled frontend assets for the correlation settings interface.

### Testing

- Verified clearing, saving, synchronizing, and reassigning the default event collection correlation on Nextcloud 33, 34, and 35.
